questions.explanation: 结合语境，作者即将实现第一次独自出国的梦想，这体现了作者拥有了去做这件事的“自由”(freedom)。后文提到的“骄傲与认可”也源于这种独立自主的自由。priority优先权，excuse借口，urge冲动，均不符语境。
questions.supplement:
A(priority): 语境句: Education should be a top priority for the government. 固定搭配: give priority to, top priority
B(freedom): 语境句: The scholarship gave her the freedom to study abroad. 固定搭配: freedom of speech, have the freedom to do
C(excuse): 语境句: He made up a clumsy excuse for being late. 固定搭配: make an excuse, find an excuse
D(urge): 语境句: She felt an overwhelming urge to tell him the truth. 固定搭配: have an urge to do, fight the urge

questions.explanation: 作者降落在完全陌生的城市，且是独自旅行(solo trip)，因此只能“依靠”自己。rely on意为“依赖，依靠”。look for寻找，trust in信任，reflect upon反思，均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(look for): 语境句: I am looking for my lost keys everywhere. 固定搭配: look for a job, look for help
B(rely on): 语境句: As babies, we rely entirely on our parents. 固定搭配: rely on oneself, rely heavily on
C(trust in): 语境句: You must trust in your own abilities to succeed. 固定搭配: trust in God, put trust in
D(reflect upon): 语境句: The manager needed time to reflect upon the problem. 固定搭配: reflect upon oneself, reflect upon the past

questions.explanation: 作者虽然来到陌生的城市，但并不害怕，打算利用好在这里的每一个“时刻”(moment)，好好享受旅行。take advantage of every moment意为“把握每分每秒”。
questions.supplement:
A(message): 语境句: Please leave a message after the beep. 固定搭配: leave a message, send a message
B(flight): 语境句: Our flight was cancelled due to the bad weather. 固定搭配: book a flight, direct flight
C(moment): 语境句: He waited for the perfect moment to ask the question. 固定搭配: at the moment, take advantage of every moment
D(platform): 语境句: The train will depart from platform 3. 固定搭配: social platform, an online platform

questions.explanation: 冒号后的问题是“我真的要孤身一人吗？”，这是出发前最“困扰”(bother)作者的问题。bother表示“使烦恼，困扰”。interested感兴趣，threatened威胁，comforted安慰，均不符合担忧的情绪语境。
questions.supplement:
A(bothered): 语境句: The noise from the construction site really bothered me. 固定搭配: bother sb with sth, can't be bothered
B(interested): 语境句: I am particularly interested in traditional Chinese medicine. 固定搭配: be interested in, keep sb interested
C(threatened): 语境句: The continuous rain threatened to ruin our picnic. 固定搭配: feel threatened, threaten to do
D(comforted): 语境句: She comforted the crying child with a warm hug. 固定搭配: comfort sb, offer comfort

questions.explanation: 前文提到作者一直担心自己会孤身一人，但实际上却遇到了很多人。这种情况与预期相反，因此用Strangely (奇怪的是) 来引出这种出乎意料的转折。
questions.supplement:
A(Initially): 语境句: Initially, I didn't like the plan, but I changed my mind later. 固定搭配: initially believe, initially plan
B(Strangely): 语境句: Strangely enough, he didn't seem angry at all. 固定搭配: strangely enough, behave strangely
C(Absolutely): 语境句: You are absolutely right about this issue. 固定搭配: absolutely necessary, absolutely true
D(Hopefully): 语境句: Hopefully, we will arrive before it gets dark. 固定搭配: hopefully finish, wait hopefully

questions.explanation: 在这第一次独自旅行中，作者“遇到，邂逅”(encounter)了许多人。encounter指偶然遇见。assist协助，amuse逗乐，guide引导，均不符合“偶遇各种各样的旅行者”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(assisted): 语境句: The software assisted users in managing their time. 固定搭配: assist sb in doing, assist with sth
B(amused): 语境句: His funny story amused all the guests at the party. 固定搭配: keep sb amused, be amused by
C(encountered): 语境句: We encountered several difficulties during the project. 固定搭配: encounter difficulties, encounter resistance
D(guided): 语境句: The local expert guided us through the dense forest. 固定搭配: guide sb through, guide dog

questions.explanation: 前文说遇到了很多人，因此作者“很少”(rarely)是一个人，甚至在想安静看书时也是如此。finally最终，apparently显然，basically基本上，都不符合句意逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(finally): 语境句: After months of hard work, they finally finished the task. 固定搭配: finally succeed, finally arrive
B(rarely): 语境句: She rarely goes out at night for safety reasons. 固定搭配: rarely seen, very rarely
C(apparently): 语境句: Apparently, he had forgotten about our appointment. 固定搭配: apparently successful, become apparently clear
D(basically): 语境句: The two models are basically the same in function. 固定搭配: basically agree, basically speaking

questions.explanation: 作者在独自旅行迷路时，会想象如果和家人在一起情况会有多么“不同”(different)。这里是在对比“独自一人”和“与家人同游”的区别。awkward尴尬，stressful有压力，complex复杂，均不如different能概括对比的含义。
questions.supplement:
A(awkward): 语境句: There was an awkward silence after his rude comment. 固定搭配: awkward situation, feel awkward
B(stressful): 语境句: Moving to a new city can be a highly stressful experience. 固定搭配: stressful job, stressful situation
C(complex): 语境句: The human brain is a highly complex organ. 固定搭配: complex system, complex problem
D(different): 语境句: Everyone learns in a slightly different way. 固定搭配: totally different, different from

questions.explanation: 夜间大巴上旁边的人一直跟作者说话，导致作者无法入睡，这件事让人感到“烦人的”(annoying)。appealing吸引人的，frightening令人害怕的，inspiring鼓舞人心的，均不符合“让人睡不着觉的喋喋不休”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(annoying): 语境句: It is annoying when people interrupt you while speaking. 固定搭配: highly annoying, find sth annoying
B(appealing): 语境句: The idea of working from home is very appealing to me. 固定搭配: visually appealing, appealing offer
C(frightening): 语境句: The thunderstorm last night was a frightening experience. 固定搭配: frightening speed, frightening reality
D(inspiring): 语境句: The headmaster gave an inspiring speech to the graduates. 固定搭配: inspiring story, truly inspiring

questions.explanation: 本题存在词汇复现。后文紧接着提到“I only felt huge positive energy!”（我只感到了巨大的正能量），因此这里是说这次旅行给了我巨大的“能量”(energy)。
questions.supplement:
A(energy): 语境句: It takes a lot of time and energy to raise a child. 固定搭配: positive energy, conserve energy
B(warmth): 语境句: She smiled with genuine warmth and welcomed us in. 固定搭配: feel the warmth, bring warmth
C(enjoyment): 语境句: Reading brings him a great deal of enjoyment. 固定搭配: pure enjoyment, find enjoyment in
D(honor): 语境句: It is a great honor to be invited to speak here. 固定搭配: in honor of, a sense of honor

questions.explanation: 由于旅行带来了巨大的正能量，因此出发前所有的怀疑和恐惧都“消失”了(disappeared)。deepened加深，remained保留，emerged出现，均与语境表达的积极结果相悖。
questions.supplement:
A(disappeared): 语境句: The sun disappeared behind a thick cloud. 固定搭配: completely disappear, gradually disappear
B(deepened): 语境句: The crisis deepened as the weather conditions worsened. 固定搭配: deepen understanding, deepen ties
C(remained): 语境句: Despite the failure, he remained optimistic about the future. 固定搭配: remain calm, remain unchanged
D(emerged): 语境句: New evidence emerged during the police investigation. 固定搭配: emerge from, newly emerged

questions.explanation: throughout my stay there意为“在那儿逗留期间”。stay在此作名词，表示停留的时间。service服务，wait等待，research研究，均不符合旅行语境。
questions.supplement:
A(service): 语境句: The restaurant is famous for its excellent customer service. 固定搭配: customer service, medical service
B(stay): 语境句: Enjoy your stay at our hotel! 固定搭配: a pleasant stay, during one's stay
C(wait): 语境句: We had a long wait for the train to arrive. 固定搭配: a long wait, lie in wait
D(research): 语境句: She is doing research into the causes of the disease. 固定搭配: do research on/into, scientific research

questions.explanation: 由but引出转折，虽然是一个计划得很周密的旅行，但它仍然是我所经历过的最“充满意外的”(unexpected)旅行。后一句“there will always be surprises and accidents”也是对unexpected的同义解释。
questions.supplement:
A(unnecessary): 语境句: We should try to avoid making unnecessary mistakes. 固定搭配: unnecessary trouble, completely unnecessary
B(unavoidable): 语境句: Mistakes are unavoidable when you are learning a new language. 固定搭配: unavoidable consequence, seem unavoidable
C(uneventful): 语境句: The flight was smooth and uneventful, which was a relief. 固定搭配: uneventful journey, relatively uneventful
D(unexpected): 语境句: He made an unexpected visit to his old school. 固定搭配: unexpected result, totally unexpected

questions.explanation: 前文提到“It was a very well-planned trip”，此处顺承该句意：“无论我们多么努力地去计划(plan)旅行，总会有惊喜和意外”。
questions.supplement:
A(plan): 语境句: It is crucial to plan your essay before you start writing. 固定搭配: plan ahead, carefully plan
B(extend): 语境句: We decided to extend our holiday by two more days. 固定搭配: extend a deadline, extend one's stay
C(adjust): 语境句: It took her a while to adjust to the new environment. 固定搭配: adjust to, adjust the volume
D(support): 语境句: My family has always supported me in my career choices. 固定搭配: fully support, financially support

questions.explanation: 经历过这次充满惊喜和正能量的独自旅行后，作者现在确实“理解”(understand)了什么是“丰富且令人难忘的经历”。suspect怀疑，remember记得，deny否认，均不契合作者旅行后的感悟与升华。
questions.supplement:
A(suspect): 语境句: The police suspect him of stealing the expensive jewelry. 固定搭配: suspect sb of sth, strongly suspect
B(remember): 语境句: Please remember to turn off the lights when you leave. 固定搭配: remember doing sth, remember to do sth
C(understand): 语境句: I can completely understand why she is so upset. 固定搭配: fully understand, be easy to understand
D(deny): 语境句: He could not deny the fact that he had made a mistake. 固定搭配: deny doing sth, strongly deny

section_2_word_form.passage:
Few animals can survive in the Gobi Desert like wild camels, where temperatures range from over 40℃ in summer to -40℃ in winter. However, experts believe that there are now only about 1,000 wild camels [56]. Luckily, rescue may be at hand from an unlikely source: space technology.
The wild camels are distributed across the vast land, [57] it impossible to track or monitor them accurately. Liu Shaochuang, [58] remote sensing specialist, realised that he was in a unique position to help with remote sensing — the use of satellites.
The first step is [59] camels with tracking collars that link to satellites, [60] can be used to determine their positions daily. Once the camels' key habitats [61], Liu's team study the environment with the remote sensing technology. They can study extensive data regarding the camels' movements, the ecological impact of climate change, [62] other potential threats, all from his desk in Beijing. It is this [63] approach to conservation that earned Liu his Rolex Award for Enterprise. Nevertheless, he [64] returns to the Gobi Desert to continue his work.
Liu's work with the wild camel is just the start, and he hopes that the series of [65] his team have developed can help protect other endangered animals.

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作后置定语。leave与前面的名词wild camels之间是动宾关系（被剩下），所以用过去分词left表示“剩下的野骆驼”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(left): 语境句: I only have ten dollars left in my wallet. 固定搭配: be left behind, nothing left。原词leave其它变形: leaving (现在分词/动名词).

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作状语。逗号前是一个完整的句子，此处用现在分词making作结果状语，表示“野骆驼分布在广阔的土地上，这使得(making)准确追踪它们变得不可能”。make与主句描述的现象是主动关系。
questions.supplement: 正确形(making): 语境句: The heavy rain continued for days, making the road impassable. 固定搭配: making it possible/impossible to do, decision-making。原词make其它常见用法: make up, make sense.

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。remote sensing specialist(遥感专家)是可数名词单数，且此处泛指“一位”遥感专家，作Liu Shaochuang的同位语。remote发音以辅音音素开头，故填a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a): 语境句: My brother is working as a computer programmer in that company. 固定搭配: a variety of, a great deal of.

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作表语。The first step is... (第一步是……)，主语是step, plan, purpose等词时，表语通常用动词不定式表示将来的具体动作。故填to fit。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to fit): 语境句: The next step is to fit the pieces together. 固定搭配: fit sth with sth (给某物安装某物), fit in with。原词fit其它变形: fitness (n.), fitted (过去式/过去分词).

questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句。逗号后是定语从句，先行词是tracking collars (或satellites，均指物)，在从句中作主语，故使用关系代词which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which): 语境句: He failed the exam again, which disappointed his parents greatly. 固定搭配: in which, of which.

questions.explanation: 考查时态、语态和主谓一致。Once引导条件/时间状语从句，主语habitats与identify之间是被动关系。结合主句“Liu's team study...”为一般现在时，从句也应用一般现在时的被动语态(或者现在完成时的被动语态have been identified)。主语为复数，故填are identified (或have been identified)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are identified): 语境句: Problems are identified and solved quickly by the team. 固定搭配: identify with, be successfully identified。原词identify其它变形: identity (n. 身份), identification (n. 鉴定，证明).

questions.explanation: 考查连词。分析句子结构，the camels' movements, the ecological impact... 和 other potential threats 是并列关系，列举了团队可以研究的三个数据方面，故填并列连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and): 语境句: She enjoys reading, painting, and playing the piano. 固定搭配: both... and..., and so on.

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。空格修饰名词approach (方法)，需要用形容词形式。innovate的形容词形式为innovative (创新的，革新的)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(innovative): 语境句: The company is known for its innovative approach to product design. 固定搭配: innovative ideas, innovative solutions。原词innovate其它变形: innovation (n. 创新), innovator (n. 创新者).

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。空格修饰动词returns，需要用副词形式。regular的副词为regularly (定期地，经常地)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(regularly): 语境句: To keep healthy, you should exercise regularly. 固定搭配: regularly update, meet regularly。原词regular其它变形: regularity (n. 规律性), irregular (adj. 不规则的).

questions.explanation: 考查名词单复数。a series of (一系列的) 后接可数名词时需用复数形式。strategy是可数名词，变复数需把y变i加es，故填strategies。
questions.supplement: 正确形(strategies): 语境句: The government has proposed several new strategies to reduce pollution. 固定搭配: a series of strategies, marketing strategies。原词strategy其它变形: strategic (adj. 战略的), strategically (adv. 战略上地).
